rules.name: Read producer delivery context for cross-repository work
rules.statement: Use the sibling KIOKU repository's `docs/agent-delivery/system.yaml`, assigned Kanban task, and linked producer contract before implementation.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Work only in the assigned worktree and branch
rules.statement: Do not reuse a shared or dirty checkout.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Do not invent producer contracts
rules.statement: When API or persisted-data behavior must change, create or link the KIOKU core task instead of forking types or behavior locally.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Preserve cross-repository traceability
rules.statement: Link the related KIOKU issue or PR and contract change in each cross-repository PR.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Separate implementation from final approval
rules.statement: An implementation session cannot approve its own final diff or release.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Require integration evidence
rules.statement: Completion needs CI-equivalent verification plus integrator confirmation that API contracts, build/typecheck, and relevant end-to-end behavior agree.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Protect secrets and release authority
rules.statement: Use 1Password as credential truth, never materialize production secrets, and leave production release decisions to the KIOKU delivery graph.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Keep packages product-neutral
rules.statement: Core packages own reusable components, tokens, themes, and build adapters, while host applications own routes, data, persistence, and domain behavior; run the package-boundary gate.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Run the repository gate
rules.statement: Use `pnpm check`; run accessibility, pack-smoke, example-build, or release verification when those surfaces change.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Record public-package changes
rules.statement: Add a Changeset for user-visible package changes and preserve protected trusted-publishing authority.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Use the assigned-worker workflow
rules.statement: Use `.agents/skills/feature-delivery/SKILL.md` when the delivery graph assigns this repository work.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.
